title: Part IV · Section 03
subtitle: Agreement
introEn: Read each item carefully. For multiple-choice items, choose the best answer. For Warm-Up and Grammar Practice, follow the instruction in each prompt and type your answer (rewritten sentence, correction, or word/phrase as asked).
